project_manifest.system_name: Vulnerability Risk Prioritization System (CVSS · EPSS · CISA KEV)
project_manifest.domain: Cybersecurity / Vulnerability Management / Multi-Criteria Decision Making (MCDM)

vulnerabilities.description: Stores raw and cached threat intelligence metrics per CVE identifier
vulnerabilities.caching_strategy: Record valid for 24 hours. If older or missing, query NVD, EPSS, and CISA KEV APIs.

prioritization_runs.description: Audit log of execution sessions containing experiment configuration

prioritization_results.description: Computed priority rankings and scores per CVE for a specific run

nvd_api.purpose: Extract CVSS v3.1 base score, severity string, and vector

epss_api.purpose: Extract current exploit prediction probability and historical pre-KEV score

cisa_kev_catalog.purpose: Match active in-the-wild exploitation status, date added, and ransomware campaign flag

prioritization_algorithm_specification.weight_redistribution_policy: If scenario excludes a feature, its weight is redistributed proportionally among active features to preserve sum(weights) == 1.0

primary_method.name: Weighted Risk Scoring + Rule-Based Escalation
primary_method.linear_formula: weighted_score = (w_cvss * cvss_norm + w_epss * epss_norm + w_kev * kev_flag) * 100

rule_based_escalation.scientific_rationale: Prevents false-negative downgrade caused by EPSS statistical decay or prediction lag on confirmed actively exploited threats.

benchmark_method.name: MCDM TOPSIS (Technique for Order Preference by Similarity to Ideal Solution)
steps: 1. Decision Matrix X (m rows: CVEs, n columns: normalized metrics)
3. Weighted Normalized Matrix: v_ij = w_j * r_ij
4. Determine Positive Ideal Solution A+ (max v_j) and Negative Ideal Solution A- (min v_j)
5. Calculate Euclidean Distances: D_i+ = sqrt(sum((v_ij - A_j+)^2)) and D_i- = sqrt(sum((v_ij - A_j-)^2))
6. Calculate Closeness Coefficient: C_i = D_i- / (D_i+ + D_i-)
7. Final TOPSIS Score: C_i * 100, ranked descending

test_1_baseline_displacement.description: Calculates the average positional delta |Rank_Primary - Rank_TOPSIS| and Top-10 set intersection.

test_2_kev_recall.formula: Recall@K = (Number of KEVs in Top-K) / Total KEVs

test_3_precision_at_k.formula: Precision@K = (Number of KEVs in Top-K) / K

test_4_historical_backtesting.description: Evaluates proactive detection by querying historical EPSS 14 days prior to CISA KEV publication date.
test_4_historical_backtesting.metric: proactive_detection_rate_pct = (KEVs classified as Critical/High pre-announcement) / Total KEVs * 100

test_6_ablation_testing.description: Stepwise comparison of Scenario 1 (CVSS), Scenario 2 (+EPSS), and Scenario 3 (+KEV) on Recall@20, Precision@20, and Average KEV Rank.

test_7_sensitivity_testing.description: Calculates pairwise Spearman rank correlation across Weight Config 1, Config 2, and Config 3.

test_8_priority_consistency.metric: Spearman rank correlation coefficient (rho) and p-value between Primary Method and TOPSIS rankings.

test_9_capacity_remediation_simulation.description: Simulates risk reduction efficiency when security teams have strict patch capacity limits vs Random and CVSS baselines.

endpoints.description: Returns database connectivity status and table record counts.
Returns 60 verified pre-cached CVE records (25 KEV + 35 Non-KEV).
Fetches intelligence from MySQL cache or queries NVD/EPSS/CISA external endpoints.
Calculates primary risk score, TOPSIS score, category, explainability text, and persists run to MySQL via batch insert.
Executes all 10 evaluation test schemes and returns comprehensive quantitative benchmarks.
Transforms JSON result array into downloadable CSV stream.

operational_instructions_for_agents.local_execution: Run 'python run.py' or 'flask run --port=5000' within the activated virtual environment.
operational_instructions_for_agents.automated_test_suite: Execute 'python test_app.py' to run unit tests verifying DB connectivity, prioritization engine, 10 evaluations, and REST routes.
operational_instructions_for_agents.deployment_routine: Commits pushed to branch 'main' on GitHub (https://github.com/anomali01/vuln-prioritization-web) trigger automated serverless build and deployment on Vercel.
operational_instructions_for_agents.critical_performance_note: Cloud MySQL is hosted remotely. Individual row inserts cause WAN latency overhead. Always use 'cursor.executemany()' for bulk persistence.
